content:
Hi everyone! I'm a researcher at the University of St Andrews in Scotland, working on formalising low level complexity theory results with LLM assistance.

I've been following the discussion about Turing machine definitions. I am so far working with Isabelle but @Samuel Schlesinger suggested that as I'm planning to translate the project to Lean also, I should stop lurking and join. The aim is a verified formal proof of the nondeterministic time hierarchy theorem. The submission target is Tau Citi, not CSLib.

There are so far four AFP entries (starting with Multitape_TM_Substrate) about the first part of our project. There is also related Python tooling for using Isabelle non-interactively (see the isabelle-watchdog and isabelle-query repos).
I asked @Kim Morrison at some point about adding CS-related things to Tau Ceti and I recall they were sticking with math. Perhaps that has changed by now
